goals: Address gaps in the architectural/building-block options available in the modpack.
scope: Provide the Stone Parapet and Stone Louvered Shutter as two AMC blocks with matching items for Minecraft Java 26.2 Fabric.

Use the Macaw masonry block classes and model parents. The parapet maps vanilla Stone directly. The shutter uses the same Stone grain at matching UV coordinates, with structural lighting measured across the reference shutter's five repeated slats.

Provide an Andesite Button and Pressure Plate using the vanilla Stone controls, and an Andesite Gothic Window and Arrow Slit using the Macaw Stone Brick forms. Each has a matching AMC item. All four bind the vanilla Andesite sprite directly to the material faces.

exclusions: Additional forms and materials, provider replacement, and IBF or BGE integration are outside this release.
Provider-derived resources and the release JAR remain in ignored local output. C1–C5 are historical provenance.

dependencies.reason: Target game, Stone redstone controls, and source of vanilla Stone, Andesite, glass and iron-bar sprites.
Loads the AMC and Macaw entrypoints on Fabric.
Supplies creative tab events and access to the vanilla control constructors.
Supplies the masonry behavior classes, model parents, conditional iron bars, tags and shutter sound. Controlled reference build used Macaw's Windows 2.4.2 for 26.2 Fabric.

state.milestone: C10 adds four Andesite forms. All eight controlled GameTests and package checks passed. The owner selected C9's Stone shutter appearance, retained in C10. Owner runtime verification and explicit acceptance of C10 are pending.

current.summary: Adds an Andesite Button, Pressure Plate, Gothic Window and Arrow Slit using the vanilla Andesite texture.
